sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-13T02:29:10.880177Z'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logs
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS h, COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-06T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY h
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS m, severity, COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY m, severity
SELECT host, COUNT(*) AS n FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' AND severity = 'ERROR' GROUP BY host ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT ts, host, body FROM logs WHERE MATCH(body, 'error') AND ts >= '2026-11-13T02:29:10.880177Z' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', ts) AS b, severity, COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY b, severity

WITH r AS (SELECT (EXTRACT(epoch FROM ts) * 1000000) / 300000000 AS y, severity FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z'), s AS (SELECT (y - (y % 1.0)) - CASE WHEN y % 1.0 < 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS b, severity FROM r) SELECT b, severity, COUNT(*) FROM s GROUP BY b, severity
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS h, service, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY h, service

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency), PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency), PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z'
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', ts) AS b, service, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY b, service
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', ts) AS b, service, approx_percentile(latency, 0.5) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY b, service
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', ts) AS b, service, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY b, service
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', ts) AS b, service, approx_percentile(latency, 0.99) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY b, service

SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', ts) AS b, service, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency), PERCENTILE_DISC(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency), PERCENTILE_DISC(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY b, service

SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', ts) AS b, service, approx_percentile(latency, 0.5), approx_percentile(latency, 0.95), approx_percentile(latency, 0.99) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z' GROUP BY b, service
SELECT approx_percentile(latency, 0.5), approx_percentile(latency, 0.95), approx_percentile(latency, 0.99) FROM logs WHERE ts >= '2026-11-12T03:29:10.880177Z'
SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency), PERCENTILE_DISC(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency), PERCENTILE_DISC(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency) FROM logs
SELECT approx_percentile(latency, 0.5), approx_percentile(latency, 0.95), approx_percentile(latency, 0.99) FROM logs
